The vlog sums up Tae so perfectly 🥹 sweet, gentle and calm but always with a hint of mischief and playfulness. This was such a beautiful way of letting us in for a bit, and I'm so grateful that he likes doing these for us. I adored all the quiet moments in between shows and being a superstar. 

I was already melting at Hobi's fond look at his two babies at the start, witnessing JK's maknae privilege in full force and Tae being the sweetest 😭 Jin always cracks me up at how he complains and protests but is somehow the main character every time, *and* he's a professional ragebaiter hahah. The dinner at the end with Jiminie was too sweet, especially with him telling us how much he's been cherishing them. 

Tae is just so lovable 😭 gets along well with everyone, and seems so oblivious to his own charms. I was so touched by him learning Spanish not just for the stage but for conversational use. My heart feels soo full 💜 the editing was amazing too! Calling it a bangtan bomb was bittersweet.
